quarterly_data.quarter: Microsoft press release: Microsoft empowers more than 330,000 Volkswagen Group (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Volkswagen Group: Microsoft announced that Volkswagen Group has equipped more than 330,000 employees with Microsoft Copilot, after a phased rollout of Copilot Chat that reached upwards of 300,000 monthly active users; employees use Copilot with Work IQ across engineering, production, procurement and sales, and more than 26,000 agents were active across the Group over the past month. Microsoft and Volkswagen Group intend to expand their collaboration and scale the Group's Intelligent Data Foundation on Microsoft Fabric.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 330,000 employees; more than 26,000 active agents
